headline: TEX @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.35 at BOS 3.30, with a projected total of 7.64. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved +0.37 runs while BOS moved -0.21, changing the projected margin by +0.58 runs. NRFI probability rose +9.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ranger Suarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ceddanne Rafaela, Josh Jung, Wilyer Abreu, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nate Eaton, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
